# Ch v0.8.3 - Table of Contents

HTTP ClickHouse driver for Elixir

## Pages

- [Ch](https://ch.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [Changelog](https://ch.hexdocs.pm/changelog.md)

## Modules

- [Ch](https://ch.hexdocs.pm/Ch.md): Minimal HTTP ClickHouse client.
- [Ch.Query](https://ch.hexdocs.pm/Ch.Query.md): Query struct wrapping the SQL statement.
- [Ch.Result](https://ch.hexdocs.pm/Ch.Result.md): Result struct returned from any successful query.

- [Ch.RowBinary](https://ch.hexdocs.pm/Ch.RowBinary.md): Helpers for working with ClickHouse [RowBinary](https://clickhouse.com/docs/en/interfaces/formats/RowBinary) format.
- [Ch.Types](https://ch.hexdocs.pm/Ch.Types.md): Helpers to turn ClickHouse types into Elixir terms for easier processing.

- Exceptions
  - [Ch.Error](https://ch.hexdocs.pm/Ch.Error.md): Error struct wrapping ClickHouse error responses.
